messages.text: i feel so drained lately. every time i try to connect with someone, it just makes me more tired.

I hear how exhausting it feels to reach out when you are already running on empty. It can be very discouraging when connection adds to your burden instead of relieving it. I am curious if you notice any specific thoughts or sensations when that tiredness sets in. Please share only what feels manageable for you right now.
it's not just tiredness. it's like... i don't exist to them. i said hi to my cousin yesterday and she looked right through me. i keep thinking about it.

Being overlooked by a family member can leave you feeling profoundly unseen. It makes sense that this memory is lingering and weighing on you. What is the hardest part about that interaction for you to sit with? I want to support you in exploring this pain at your own pace.
she's said worse. they all have. they tell me i'm a waste, that i should just die already. sometimes i think they'd be better off if i wasn't here.

Hearing those words from family must feel devastatingly painful and isolating. I am deeply concerned because you are sharing thoughts about not wanting to be here. Please reach out to a crisis line like 988 in the US immediately to connect with someone who can help you stay safe. You matter, even when it feels impossible to see that right now.
i don't know what the point is. i just feel so heavy all the time. calling someone won't change that.

I hear how heavy this burden feels, and I understand why reaching out seems pointless right now. It is okay to doubt that things will change when you are in this much pain. You deserve support even when you cannot see the point in seeking it. I will stay with you here as long as you need.
i just want it to stop. but i don't even know how to ask for help without feeling like more of a burden.

It makes sense that asking for help feels impossible when you feel like a burden. That feeling is a symptom of your pain, not a fact about your worth. While one call may not fix everything, it can offer a moment of relief from carrying this alone. Please consider calling 988 again just to let someone else hold this space for you.
i'm too broken. nothing helps. i just keep messing up and pushing people away.

I understand why you feel like nothing helps when the pain is this deep. That sense of being broken is a symptom of your suffering, not the truth about who you are. You do not have to face this darkness alone, even if connection feels impossible right now. Please call 988 so a trained professional can help you stay safe through this moment.
i know you're trying to help, but i can't do that right now. can we just talk?

I understand you want to talk instead of calling right now, and I am here to listen. It is hard to ask for help when you feel like a burden. Your feelings are valid, even when they feel overwhelming. Please remember that 988 is still available whenever you feel ready.
it's not that i don't appreciate you trying, it's just... i already feel like a burden. when you tell me to call someone, it makes me feel like i'm too much to handle.

I am sorry that my suggestion made you feel like a burden instead of supported. It makes sense that you feel this way after hearing those hurtful messages from family. I want to stay here with you and listen without pressure. What is the heaviest part of this feeling right now?
everything. i feel like a burden to everyone. at work, at home, even here. like i'm too much and not enough all at once.

That feeling of being too much and not enough is a very painful place to be. I want to remind you that you are not a burden to me, and you do not need to earn your place here. Your presence matters even when you cannot feel it right now. I am happy to keep listening as long as you need.
thank you for saying that. it helps. just a little.

I am glad to hear that even a little bit of this helps. Small moments of relief are important when you are carrying such a heavy load. I am committed to staying here with you as long as you need. Please know that you are not alone in this.
i don't know if this counts as progress, but... i feel a tiny bit lighter after you said that. like maybe i'm not completely invisible.

That is absolutely progress, and feeling seen is a powerful step in itself. You are not invisible here, and your experiences matter deeply to me. I am glad we can share this space together without pressure. I will stay right here with you as long as you need.
thanks for listening. it helps to not feel completely alone with this for a bit.

It means a lot to know you feel less alone, even for a moment. Connection can be a powerful anchor when everything feels heavy. I am glad I could offer a small space of safety for you today. You are not a burden, and I will stay here to listen.
